text:
sam: Quick heads-up — after switching to the new fused-attn kernel on eu-west cluster we saw higher 95th pct latency for small batches when cross-zone spillover happens.
linh: Hmm, numbers?
sam: perf snapshot -> 95p increase from 120ms -> 220ms during spill events. Here's the flame from our trace:
```
span: batch_form(3-5ms)
span: kernel_fused_attn(30-70ms)
span: kv_lookup(4-6ms)
span: cross_zone_network(80-120ms)
```
linh: Looks like cross_zone_network is dominating when KV misses cascade and batch formation waits. Did we change batch_window?
maria: We did — prod config moved from 6ms -> 10ms to improve throughput, and token_budget_target lowered from 64 -> 48.
sam: Exactly. Longer window + smaller token budget means more small-ish batches get held and then spilled -> remote nodes, more network hops.
linh: Proposed quick mitigations:
- revert batch_window to 6ms for eu-west
- bump token_budget_target back to 64
- add spill_policy=prefer_local_and_capacity to reduce cross-zone spill
derek: Can we also tweak kernel selection: prefer non-fused for <64-token batches? Fused-attn better at long seqs but cost per-call seems worse for tiny batches.
sam: I profiled kernel latency by seq len and batch size:
```
# approximate med lat (ms)
fused_attn: batch=1 seq=32 -> 22ms
fused_attn: batch=8 seq=32 -> 90ms
nonfused: batch=1 seq=32 -> 15ms
nonfused: batch=8 seq=32 -> 80ms
```
maria: So nonfused wins at small batch sizes.
ops-bot: deploy-triggered: canary rollout for 'eu-west-kernel-prefs' queued.
linh: Plan: 1) canary kernel pref change (nonfused for tiny batches) 2) revert batch_window temporarily 3) monitor KV hit rate and cross-zone egress (dashboard link: https://perf.redwood/d/abc/kv-spill) 4) if canary stable, roll to prod.
sam: I'll open a small PR with config diff and add a smoke test for spill scenarios. ping @maria for rollout.
maria: ack. I'll watch charts and set an alert on cross-zone egress > 50MB/min.
derek: Also add a short-term token budget delta experiment: +20% token budget for 30m during canary to see effect.
linh: Thanks — let's meet in 15 to sync after canary starts :thumbsup:
ops-bot: canary started at 1945678920
maria: initial results after 2m: 95p latency down from 220ms -> 145ms in canary nodes. KV miss rate unchanged.
sam: Good sign. We'll collect 10m more and then decide.
